title: Capture of Oujda (1647)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Oujda (1647)", at revision 1292600657, opens: "The Capture of Oujda in 1647 was a battle between the forces of the Alaouite Sharif Sultan Moulay Mohammed and the Turks of Algiers. It led to the capture of the city of Oujda by the Alaouite Sultanate of Tafilalt, then an expanding political force in the Maghreb." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q109312791, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1647 battle in Algeria". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
